name: Germany
registration_steps: Voter registration is automatic in Germany if you are registered as a resident
Register your residence at the local Registration Office (Einwohnermeldeamt) when you move
You will automatically be added to the electoral roll
About 6-8 weeks before the election, you'll receive a Wahlbenachrichtigung (voting notification card)
Check if your details are correct on the voting notification card
Contact your local Electoral Office if you did not receive a card
voting_steps: Find your polling station on your Wahlbenachrichtigung (voting notification card)
Bring your voting notification card and a valid ID (ID card or passport)
Go to your polling station on election day (8am - 6pm)
Present your voting notification card and ID to officials
Receive two ballot papers (first vote for direct candidate, second vote for party list)
Mark an X on your chosen candidate (first ballot) and party (second ballot)
Fold both ballots and place them in the ballot box
notes: Germany uses a mixed-member proportional representation system. EU citizens residing in Germany can vote in European Parliament and local elections. Postal voting is widely available.
